_comment: Gleam form tuning (scripts/core/GleamRules.gd). Wild chance of a kind = (1 + min(chain, chain_max) * chain_step) * mult / one_in; the classic kind uses wild_one_in. One draw decides the kind: classic first, then the rarer kinds in this order. The shop's Shimmer Scent only scales the classic kind, so no rare kind can be bought. Palettes: data/gleam_palettes.json (tools/art/gen_gleam_palettes.py reads "palette"); "tier" recolours art of tiers II to V (shaders/gleam_hue.gdshader); "cycle" turns the hues in turns per second.
